sanskrit:
कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः ।
लोकसङ्ग्रहमेवापि सम्पश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि ॥ ३-२०॥
iast:
karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ
lokasaṅgrahamevāpi sampaśyankartumarhasi 3-20
translation: Janaka and others attained Perfection verily by action only; even with a view to protecting the masses you should perform action.
